title: createFile
body:
## createFile

Build a new HDF5 file from declared groups, typed datasets, attributes, units, dimension scales, chunked compression, fill values, resizable axes, links, committed datatypes, virtual datasets and external raw storage, with values from literals, documented generators, captured CSV/NPY/raw inputs or in-file copies.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Every object is addressed by its absolute HDF5 path (Unicode names such as /Experiment 1/Temperature (°C) are ordinary); parent groups are created implicitly.
- Values are flattened in row-major (C) order; floats are rounded once to the declared precision and out-of-range integers are refused.
- Publication requires host expectations to agree with a fresh h5py readback and the HDF Group h5dump XML reading.

Native binding: `h5py.File(w, libver, userblock_size, track_order, driver) / create_group / create_dataset(dtype, shape, maxshape, chunks, compression, shuffle, fletcher32, scaleoffset, fillvalue, external) / VirtualLayout / attrs.create / dims / SoftLink / ExternalLink`. Output kind: `["file","text","table"]`.

Inputs: none.
